description: This file implements a consumer application that interacts with an RBUS bus. It sets up event subscriptions, adds and removes entries in tables, and handles various event types such as object creation, deletion, and value changes. The code demonstrates complex RBUS operations including subscriptions, event handling, and table management.

methods.name: void eventReceiveHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusEvent_t const * event,rbusEventSubscription_t * subscription)
methods.description: Handles different RBUS event types: object created, object deleted, value changed, and initial value. Prints information based on event data.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Main function that initializes RBUS, subscribes to events, manages tables and entries, updates data, and cleans up before exit.
